analysis: The code snippet is in a method getInputStream() that obtains an InputStream by calling getResourceAsStream on either this.clazz or this.classLoader, depending on whether this.clazz is not null. The argument to getResourceAsStream is this.path. The API documentation for getResourceAsStream declares only NullPointerException if the resource name is null. It does not declare other exceptions; conditions like resource not found, package not opened, or security access denial result in a null return. In the snippet, there is no null check on this.path before passing it to getResourceAsStream. Therefore, if this.path is null, the API will throw NullPointerException. The code also throws FileNotFoundException if the stream is null, but that is not an exception of the API method. So among the exceptions declared by getResourceAsStream, NullPointerException is not avoided.
answer: The only declared exception of getResourceAsStream is NullPointerException. Its throwing condition (resource name is null) is not avoided because the code does not check if this.path is null before calling the method.
